title: Warm Peppery French Tomato Tarte Tatin
description: A post-workout French dish inspired by the flavors of Lyon, featuring san marzano tomatoes and a nut-free shio koji cure.
instructions: Combine rehydrated shio koji cure, coarse black pepper, minced garlic, and thyme leaves in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together sugar and salt. Stir in softened butter until well combined.
Add the flour mixture to the bowl with the shio koji cure mixture and stir until just combined.
In a well-floured surface, roll out the warm water and knead the dough until smooth and pliable.
Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and roll out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 10-inch (25cm) kazan cauldron or tarte tatin dish.
Arrange the halved San Marzano tomatoes on top of the dough in a concentric circle pattern.
Dollop the shio koji cure mixture over the tomatoes, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C) for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5-7 minutes before serving.
